description: This file defines a Java class named LoanAvailableDisbursementAmountModificationCommandHandler that handles commands to modify the available disbursement amount for a loan. It uses Spring annotations for service and transaction management, and implements a handler interface to process commands by calling a service method.

classes.name: LoanAvailableDisbursementAmountModificationCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that processes command requests to update the available disbursement amount for a loan, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the provided command to modify the loan's available disbursement amount by invoking the related service method within a transactional context.
